description_en: Pushes notifications or messages to various device endpoints. This operation provides a variety of custom push parameters to implement push behaviors in different scenarios
description_zh: 高级推送接口，推送通知或者消息到不同设备端，本接口提供丰富的推送定制参数，以实现不同场景下的推送行为
kebab_example: aliyun push push --app-key 23267207 --push-type MESSAGE --device-type HARMONY --target ALL --target-value ALL --region cn-hangzhou
name: Push

parameters.help_en: The AppKey information
parameters.help_zh: AppKey信息
parameters.name: app_key

parameters.help_en:
The push type. Valid values:
NOTICE: notification. Notifications are delivered to device endpoints through vendor channels such as APNs, Huawei, Xiaomi, and HarmonyOS, and are directly displayed in the notification bar of the device. When an Android device is online (the app process is alive), notifications are preferentially delivered through the Alibaba Cloud proprietary channel. The push SDK constructs and displays the notifications to achieve better push performance and save vendor push message quotas in certain scenarios.
MESSAGE: message. Messages are delivered through the Alibaba Cloud proprietary online channel and are not displayed in the notification bar by default. The app must receive and process the messages when the process is active, and the business logic determines whether to trigger specific business behaviors. When a device is offline (the app process is inactive), messages cannot be received in a timely manner. In this case, you can use the iOSRemind or AndroidRemind parameter to convert messages into notifications for delivery when the device is offline. Alternatively, you can set the StoreOffline parameter to allow the push system to save the messages when the device is offline and automatically deliver the messages when the device comes online
parameters.help_zh:
推送类型。取值：
NOTICE：表示通知。通知的特点是会走APNs、华为、小米、鸿蒙等厂商通道下发到设备端，并直接在设备通知栏弹出。当Android设备在线(App进程存活)时，它会优先走阿里云自有通道，由推送SDK构造通知并弹出，从而获得更好的推送性能，并在某些场景下能节省厂商推送消息额度。
MESSAGE：表示消息。消息的特点是会走阿里云自有在线通道下发，它不会默认在通知栏弹出，而是需要由App在进程活跃时接收并处理，由业务自行决定是否触发某些业务行为。设备离线(App进程不活跃)时，将无法及时接收到消息，此时可以通过下述的`iOSRemind`或`AndroidRemind`参数，在设备离线时将消息转为通知下发；或者设置下述的`StoreOffline`参数，在设备离线时，由推送系统保存该消息，等设备上线后再自动将消息下发
parameters.name: push_type

parameters.help_en:
The device type. Valid values:

HARMONY: HarmonyOS devices.
iOS: iOS devices.
ANDROID: Android devices.
ALL: If the AppKey belongs to a legacy dual-platform application, this value indicates that messages are pushed to both Android and iOS devices. If the AppKey belongs to a new single-platform application, this value has the same effect as specifying the device type that corresponds to the application type
parameters.help_zh:
设备类型，取值范围为：

HARMONY：鸿蒙设备
iOS：iOS设备
ANDROID：Android设备
ALL：当AppKey为旧版本双端应用时，代表同时推送Android和iOS设备；当AppKey为新版本单端应用时，效果和指定该应用类型对应的设备类型一样
parameters.name: device_type

parameters.help_en:
The push target. Valid values:

DEVICE: pushes messages based on devices.
ACCOUNT: pushes messages based on accounts.
ALIAS: pushes messages based on aliases.
TAG: pushes messages based on tags.
ALL: pushes messages to all devices. The interval between two full pushes for the same DeviceType must be at least 1 second.
A full push to iOS devices delivers messages to devices that have been active but not uninstalled within the last 24 months. Once Apple Push Notification service (APNs) receives the push request and does not return an error message, the message is considered delivered. This may cause a surge in the number of active devices and incur high costs. Use this value with caution.
TBD: initializes a continuous push. The push target is specified by the subsequent https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2249917.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
推送目标。可取值：

DEVICE：根据设备推送。
ACCOUNT：根据账号推送。
ALIAS：根据别名推送。
TAG：根据标签推送。
ALL：推送给全部设备（同一种DeviceType的两次全推的间隔至少为1秒）。
对iOS设备全推，会推送给24个月内活跃过但未卸载的设备，一旦APNs（苹果推送服务）接收到推送请求且未返回错误信息即为送达，导致活跃设备数暴增，从而产生大量费用，请您酌情使用。
TBD：初始化持续推送，推送目标由后续的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2249917.html接口指定
parameters.name: target

parameters.help_en:
The target value, which is set based on the Target type. Separate multiple values with commas (,). If the number of values exceeds the limit, you must push messages in multiple batches.

If Target is set to DEVICE, the value is in the format of `deviceid1,deviceid2`. A maximum of 1,000 devices are supported.
If Target is set to ACCOUNT, the value is in the format of `account1,account2`. A maximum of 1,000 accounts are supported.
If Target is set to ALIAS, the value is in the format of `alias1,alias2`. A maximum of 1,000 aliases are supported.
If Target is set to TAG, single and multiple tags are supported. For more information about the format, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434847.html.
If Target is set to ALL, the value is ALL, which is a fixed parameter combination for full pushes.
If Target is set to TBD, the value is TBD, which is a fixed parameter combination for continuous pushes
parameters.help_zh:
根据Target类型来设定，多个值使用逗号分隔，超过限制需要分多次推送。

Target=DEVICE，值如`deviceid1,deviceid2`（最多支持1000个）。
Target=ACCOUNT，值如`account1,account2`（最多支持1000个）。
Target=ALIAS，值如`alias1,alias2`（最多支持1000个）。
Target=TAG，支持单Tag和多Tag，格式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434847.html。
Target=ALL，值为ALL（全推固定参数组合）。
Target=TBD，值为TBD（持续推送固定参数组合）
parameters.name: target_value

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to save offline messages and notifications. Default value: false.

If this parameter is set to true, offline messages and notifications are saved. If a user is offline during a push, the saved messages and notifications are delivered again when the user comes online within the expiration time specified by ExpireTime. The default value of ExpireTime is 72 hours. iOS notifications are delivered through the APNs channel and are not affected by the StoreOffline parameter
parameters.help_zh:
离线消息、通知是否保存。StoreOffline默认设置为false。

若保存，在推送时候用户不在线，在过期时间（ExpireTime）内用户上线时会被再次发送。ExpireTime默认为72小时。iOS通知走APNs链路，不受StoreOffline影响
parameters.name: store_offline

parameters.help_en:
The specified delivery channels. Valid values:

accs: Alibaba Cloud proprietary channel
huawei: Huawei channel
honor: Honor channel
xiaomi: Xiaomi channel
oppo: OPPO channel
vivo: vivo channel
meizu: Meizu channel
gcm: Google GCM channel (legacy HTTP)
fcm: Google Firebase channel (HTTP v1 API)
apns: APNs channel
harmony: HarmonyOS channel

If this parameter is not configured, all channels are available.
If this parameter is configured, only the specified channels are used.
If the configured channels conflict with the delivery policy (for example, iOS notifications are delivered only through the APNs channel, but apns is not included in this parameter), the delivery is not performed.
If gcm is configured, both the Google GCM and FCM channels can be used. If fcm is configured, only the Google FCM channel can be used
parameters.help_zh:
指定发送通道，取值如下：

accs：阿里云自有通道
huawei：华为通道
honor：荣耀通道
xiaomi：小米通道
oppo：OPPO通道
vivo：vivo通道
meizu：魅族通道
gcm：谷歌GCM通道（旧版HTTP）
fcm: 谷歌Firebase通道（HTTP v1 API）
apns：APNs通道
harmony: 鸿蒙通道

如果未配置此参数，则代表所有通道均可使用。
如果配置了此参数，则严格使用参数中的通道。
如果配置的通道和发送策略冲突（如iOS通知仅走APNs通道，但本参数中不包含apns），则不实施发送。
若配置gcm，则可以走谷歌GCM和FCM通道，若配置fcm，则只能走谷歌FCM通道
parameters.name: send_channels

parameters.help_en:
The scheduled delivery time. If this parameter is not set, messages are delivered immediately.
The scheduled delivery time cannot be later than 7 days from the current time.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard. The time must be in UTC and in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format.
If Target is set to TBD (continuous push), scheduled delivery is not supported
parameters.help_zh:
用于定时发送。不设置缺省是立即发送。
设置定时发送最迟不能晚于7天发送。

时间格式按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ。
Target为TBD（持续推送）时，不支持定时设置
parameters.name: push_time

parameters.help_en:
The expiration time of offline messages and notifications. This parameter is used together with StoreOffline. Expired messages and notifications are no longer delivered. Messages and notifications can be saved for a maximum of 72 hours. Default value: 72 hours.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard. The time must be in UTC and in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The expiration time cannot be earlier than the current time or the scheduled delivery time plus 3 seconds (ExpireTime > PushTime + 3 seconds). The 3-second buffer is used to compensate for errors caused by network and system latency. Set the expiration time to no less than 1 minute for single pushes and no less than 10 minutes for full pushes and batch pushes
parameters.help_zh:
离线消息/通知的过期时间，和StoreOffline配合使用，过期则不会再被发送，最长保存72小时。默认为72小时。

时间格式按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ，过期时间不能小于当前时间或者定时发送时间加上3秒（`ExpireTime > PushTime+ 3秒`），3秒是为了冗余网络和系统延迟造成的误差。建议单推不小于1分钟，全推、批量推送不少于10分钟
parameters.name: expire_time

parameters.help_en:
The custom identifier of the push task. If JobKey is not empty, this field is included in the receipt log. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434651.html.
Format requirements: The value can contain only letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-), and cannot exceed 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
推送任务自定义标识，当JobKey不为空时，回执日志中会附带该字段。查看回执日志参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434651.html。
格式要求：只能使用字母或数字或符号‘_’、‘-’任意一项或组合 ，且长度不超过32个字符
parameters.name: job_key

parameters.help_en:
The title of the notification or message during the push. Maximum length: 200 bytes.

This parameter is required for Android and HarmonyOS pushes. This parameter is optional for iOS notifications. If this parameter is specified:

For iOS 10 and later, the title is displayed in the notification.

For iOS 8.2 to iOS 9.x, the title replaces the application name in the notification
parameters.help_zh:
推送时通知/消息的标题，长度限制：200字节。

在Android和Harmony推送时必填；在iOS通知时非必填，如果填写，则：

iOS 10+通知显示标题。

iOS 8.2 <= iOS系统 < iOS 10：替换通知应用名称
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en: The content of the notification or message for Android and HarmonyOS pushes, or the content of the iOS message or notification. The content size is limited. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434629.html
parameters.help_zh: Android和Harmony推送时通知的内容/消息的内容；iOS消息/通知内容，推送的内容大小是有限制的，参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434629.html
parameters.name: body

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically truncate excessively long titles and content.

This parameter applies only to vendor channels that explicitly limit the length of titles and content. It does not apply to channels such as APNs, Huawei, and Honor, which do not limit the length of titles and content but only limit the total request body size
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动对过长标题、内容进行截断。

仅支持明确限制标题、内容的厂商通道，对APNs、华为、荣耀通道等不限制标题、内容，只限制总请求体大小的不适用
parameters.name: trim

parameters.help_en:
The environment context for iOS notifications. To send iOS notifications through the APNs center, specify the corresponding environment context. Valid values:

DEV: the development environment, which applies to applications that are directly installed and debugged by using Xcode.
PRODUCT: the production environment, which applies to applications distributed through the App Store, TestFlight, Ad Hoc, and enterprise distribution
parameters.help_zh:
iOS的通知是通过APNs中心来发送的，需要填写对应的环境信息。

DEV：开发环境，适用于Xcode直接安装调试的应用。
PRODUCT：生产环境，适用于 App Store、TestFlight、Ad Hoc 及企业分发的应用
parameters.name: ios_apns_env

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to convert an offline message into a notification. If a device is offline during a message push (that is, the persistent connection channel to the Mobile Push server is disconnected), the message is delivered once as a notification through the Apple APNs channel.

Converting offline messages into notifications applies only to the production environment
parameters.help_zh:
消息推送时设备不在线（即与移动推送的服务端的长连接通道不通），则这条推送会做为通知，通过苹果的APNs通道送达一次。

离线消息转通知仅适用于生产环境
parameters.name: ios_remind

parameters.help_en: The subtitle of the iOS notification (iOS 10 and later)
parameters.help_zh: iOS通知副标题内容（iOS 10+）
parameters.name: ios_subtitle

parameters.help_en: The iOS notification content used when an iOS message is converted into a notification. This parameter takes effect only when iOSApnsEnv is set to PRODUCT and iOSRemind is set to true
parameters.help_zh: iOS消息转通知时使用的iOS通知内容，仅当iOSApnsEnv=PRODUCT && iOSRemind为true时有效
parameters.name: ios_remind_body

parameters.help_en:
The sound of the iOS notification. Specify the name of the audio file stored in the app bundle or the sandbox Library/Sounds directory. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/48906.html.

If this parameter is set to an empty string (""), the notification is silent. If this parameter is not set, the default value is default, which indicates the system prompt sound
parameters.help_zh:
iOS通知声音。指定存放在app bundle或沙盒Library/Sounds目录下的音频文件名，请参见：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/48906.html。

若指定为空串（””），通知为静音；若不设置，默认填充default为系统提示音
parameters.name: ios_music

parameters.help_en:
The badge number displayed in the upper-right corner of the iOS application icon.

If iOSBadgeAutoIncrement is set to true, this parameter must be left empty
parameters.help_zh:
iOS应用图标右上角角标。

若iOSBadgeAutoIncrement设置为True，则此项必须为空
parameters.name: ios_badge

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the automatic badge increment feature. Default value: false.

When this parameter is set to true, iOSBadge must be left empty.

The automatic badge increment feature maintains the badge count for each device on the push server. This feature requires SDK version 1.9.5 or later, and users must actively synchronize the badge number to the server
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启角标自增功能，默认为false。

当该项为true时，iOSBadge必须为空。

角标自增功能由推送服务端维护每个设备的角标计数，需要用户使用1.9.5以上版本的SDK，并且需要用户主动同步角标数字到服务端
parameters.name: ios_badge_auto_increment

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable silent notifications for iOS
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启iOS静默通知
parameters.name: ios_silent_notification

parameters.help_en: The iOS notification processing extension flag (iOS 10 and later). If this parameter is set to true, notifications pushed by APNs can be processed by the extension before they are displayed. This parameter must be set to true for silent notifications
parameters.help_zh: iOS通知处理扩展标记（iOS 10+）。如果设为true，则APNs推送的通知在弹出前，可先到达Extension进行处理。静默通知时，必须设为true
parameters.name: ios_mutable_content

parameters.help_en: The category of the iOS notification (iOS 10 and later)
parameters.help_zh: 指定iOS通知Category（iOS 10+）
parameters.name: ios_notification_category

parameters.help_en: The collapse ID of the iOS notification. If a device receives messages with the same CollapseId, the messages are merged into one. If the device is offline and continuously receives messages with the same CollapseId, only one notification is displayed in the notification bar. This parameter is supported in iOS 10 and later
parameters.help_zh: 设备收到有相同CollapseId的消息，会合并成一条。设备不在线，连续发相同CollapseId的消息，通知栏只会显示一条，iOS 10+支持设置此参数
parameters.name: ios_notification_collapse_id

parameters.help_en:
The thread ID used to group iOS remote notifications and mark the identifier of the collapsed group.
This parameter is supported only in iOS 12.0 and later
parameters.help_zh:
通过该属性对iOS的远程通知进行分组，标记折叠的组别识别名。
仅支持iOS 12.0+版本
parameters.name: ios_notification_thread_id

parameters.help_en:
The interruption level. Valid values:

passive: The system adds the notification to the notification list without turning on the screen or playing a sound.
active: The system immediately displays the notification, turns on the screen, and can play a sound.
time-sensitive: The system immediately presents the notification, turns on the screen, and can play a sound, but does not break through the system notification controls.
critical: The system immediately displays the notification, turns on the screen, and plays a sound bypassing the silent switch
parameters.help_zh:
中断级别，取值：

passive：系统在不点灯、不播放声音的情况下将通知添加到通知列表中。
active：系统立即显示通知，点亮屏幕，并可以播放声音。
time-sensitive：系统立即呈现通知，点亮屏幕，并可以播放声音，但不会突破系统通知控制。
critical：系统立即显示通知，屏幕亮起，并绕过静音开关播放声音
parameters.name: ios_interruption_level

parameters.help_en: The relevance score for summary highlighting. Valid values: a floating-point number in the range of [0, 1]
parameters.help_zh: 摘要突出显示分数。取值范围：[0,1]的浮点数
parameters.name: ios_relevance_score

parameters.help_en:
The extension property of the iOS notification.

For iOS 10 and later, you can specify the resource URL for rich media push notifications in this parameter: `{"attachment": "https://www.example.com/notification_pic.png"}`. This parameter must be passed in JSON map format. Otherwise, a parse error occurs
parameters.help_zh:
iOS通知的扩展属性。

iOS10+可以在此指定富媒体推送通知的资源Url：`{"attachment": "https://www.example.com/notification_pic.png"} `。该参数要以JSON map的格式传入，否则会解析出错
parameters.name: ios_ext_parameters

parameters.help_en: The event of the live activity. Valid values: start, update, and end
parameters.help_zh:
启动、更新、结束实时活动。

枚举：start | update | end
parameters.name: ios_live_activity_event

parameters.help_en: The live activity ID reported by the device to the user server. This is the unique identifier of the live activity
parameters.help_zh: 由设备上报到用户服务器的Live Activity ID，Live Activity的唯一标识符
parameters.name: ios_live_activity_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the live activity to be started.
This parameter is required when iOSLiveActivityEvent is set to start
parameters.help_zh:
待启动的Live Activity类型。
iOSLiveActivityEvent为start时必填
parameters.name: ios_live_activity_attributes_type

parameters.help_en:
The JSON string that contains the static pass-through parameters for Dynamic Island pushes. Static parameter includes static user-defined information, such as product IDs and order information.

Static parameter is required when iOSLiveActivityEvent is set to start
parameters.help_zh:
JSON字符串，灵动岛推送透传静态参数。包含静态的用户自定义信息，如产品编号、订单信息等。

iOSLiveActivityEvent为start时必填
parameters.name: ios_live_activity_attributes

parameters.help_en: The pass-through dynamic parameter for Dynamic Island pushes. This parameter includes real-time update information, such as price and inventory changes
parameters.help_zh: 灵动岛推送透传动态参数，包含实时更新信息，如价格、库存变化等
parameters.name: ios_live_activity_content_state

parameters.help_en: The UNIX timestamp in seconds. The ended live activity is retained on the Lock Screen until the specified time, for a maximum of 4 hours
parameters.help_zh: 秒级时间戳，结束的Live Activity在锁屏上会保留到该指定时间，最长为4小时
parameters.name: ios_live_activity_dismissal_date

parameters.help_en: The UNIX timestamp in seconds that marks the expiration time of the activity content
parameters.help_zh: 秒级时间戳，标记该活动的内容过期时间
parameters.name: ios_live_activity_stale_date

parameters.help_en:
The reminder method for the notification. Valid values:

VIBRATE: vibration. This is the default value.
SOUND: sound.
BOTH: sound and vibration.
NONE: silent
parameters.help_zh:
通知的提醒方式。可取值：

VIBRATE：振动（默认值）
SOUND：声音
BOTH：声音和振动
NONE：静音
parameters.name: android_notify_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the auxiliary pop-up window feature when a device is offline during a message push. Default value: false. This parameter takes effect only when PushType is set to MESSAGE.

If the message is successfully converted into a notification and pushed, the data displayed in the received notification is the value of the AndroidPopupTitle and AndroidPopupBody parameters set on the server. When you click the notification, the data obtained in the onSysNoticeOpened method of the auxiliary pop-up window is the value of the Title and Body parameters set on the server
parameters.help_zh:
推送类型为消息时设备不在线，则这条推送会使用辅助弹窗功能。默认值为false，仅当PushType=MESSAGE时生效。

如果消息转通知推送成功，收到通知是展示的数据为服务端设置的AndroidPopupTitle和AndroidPopupBody参数值，点击通知在辅助弹窗的onSysNoticeOpened方法中获取到的数据是服务端设置的Title和Body参数值
parameters.name: android_remind

parameters.help_en:
The action performed after the notification is clicked. Valid values:

APPLICATION: opens the application. This is the default value.
ACTIVITY: opens the specified Android activity of the application.
URL: opens the specified URL.
NONE: performs no redirection
parameters.help_zh:
点击通知后动作。可取值：

APPLICATION：打开应用（默认值）
ACTIVITY：打开应用AndroidActivity
URL：打开URL
NONE：无跳转

parameters.help_en:
The activity to be opened by the notification.

This parameter is passed only when AndroidOpenType is set to ACTIVITY. Example: `com.alibaba.cloudpushdemo.bizactivity`
parameters.help_zh:
设定通知打开的activity。

仅当AndroidOpenType=”Activity”时传入，如：`com.alibaba.cloudpushdemo.bizactivity`
parameters.name: android_activity

parameters.help_en:
The URL to be opened after an Android device receives the push.

This parameter is passed only when AndroidOpenType is set to URL
parameters.help_zh:
Android收到推送后打开对应的url。

仅当AndroidOpenType=”URL”时传入
parameters.name: android_open_url

parameters.help_en: The activity to which the user is redirected after the notification is clicked
parameters.help_zh: 指定点击通知后跳转的Activity
parameters.name: android_popup_activity

parameters.help_en:

长度限制：50个字符，中英文都算一个字符。

如使用厂商通道，则需同时符合厂商通道的限制，具体内容参见：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/165253.html
parameters.name: android_popup_title

Maximum length: 200 characters. Both Chinese and English characters count as one character.

If a vendor channel is used, the content must also meet the limits of the vendor channel. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/165253.html
parameters.help_zh:
辅助弹窗模式下Body内容。AndroidPopupActivity参数不为空时，该参数必填。

长度限制：200个字符，中英文都算一个字符。

如使用厂商通道，则需同时符合厂商通道的限制，具体内容参见：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/165253.html
parameters.name: android_popup_body

The notification style. Valid values:
0: standard mode. This is the default value.
1: long text mode. This mode supports Huawei, Honor, Xiaomi, OPPO, Meizu, and the proprietary channel.
2: big picture mode. This mode supports the proprietary channel but does not support Xiaomi models.
3: inbox mode. This mode supports Huawei, Honor, Xiaomi, OPPO, and the proprietary channel.
If a non-standard mode is used, this parameter must be provided
parameters.help_zh:
通知样式，取值为：
0：标准模式（默认）
1：长文本模式（支持华为、荣耀、小米、OPPO、魅族、自有通道）
2：大图模式（支持自有通道，不支持小米机型）
3：列表模式（支持华为、荣耀、小米、OPPO、自有通道）
若使用非标准模式，此参数必须提供
parameters.name: android_render_style

parameters.help_en:
The title in long text mode. Maximum length: 200 bytes. One Chinese character counts as 3 bytes.

This parameter is currently supported only by the Honor channel and the Huawei channel with EMUI 11 and later.

If this parameter is not provided in long text mode, the first non-empty value from Title and AndroidPopupTitle is used
parameters.help_zh:
长文本模式下的标题，长度限制：200个字节（1个汉字算作3字节）。

当前仅支持荣耀通道和华为通道EMUI11及以上版本。

若长文本模式下未提供此参数，则从Title、AndroidPopupTitle里取第一个非空值
parameters.name: android_big_title

parameters.help_en:
The body in long text mode. Maximum length: 1,000 bytes. One Chinese character counts as 3 bytes. The actual limit is subject to the specific vendor channel during delivery.

Supported channels:

Huawei: EMUI 10 and later

Honor: Magic UI 4.0 and later

Xiaomi: MIUI 10 and later

OPPO: ColorOS 5.0 and later

Meizu: Flyme 
Proprietary channel: Android SDK 3.6.0 and later

If this parameter is not provided in long text mode, the first non-empty value from Body and AndroidPopupBody is used
parameters.help_zh:
长文本模式下的body，长度限制：1000字节（1个汉字算作3字节），发送时受具体厂商通道的限制。

当前支持：

　华为：EMUI10及以上

　荣耀：Magic UI 4.0及以上

　小米：MIUI10及以上

　OPPO：ColorOS 5.0以上

　魅族：Flyme 
　自有通道：安卓SDK3.6.0及以上

若长文本模式下未提供此参数，则从Body、AndroidPopupBody里取第一个非空值
parameters.name: android_big_body

parameters.help_en: The image URL in big picture mode. Supported channels: proprietary channel with Android SDK 3.6.0 and later
parameters.help_zh: 大图模式下的图片URL，当前支持：自有通道：安卓SDK3.6.0及以上
parameters.name: android_big_picture_url

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] This parameter is deprecated. Starting from August 2023, Xiaomi officially no longer supports dynamically setting small icons, right-side icons, and big pictures during pushes on new devices and systems
parameters.help_zh: 该参数已废弃，小米从 2023.08 开始，官方在新设备/系统已经不再支持推送时动态设置小图标、右侧图标、大图片功能
parameters.name: android_xiaomi_big_picture_url

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the right-side icon.
Supported channels:
Huawei EMUI: applies only to long text mode and inbox mode.

Honor Magic UI: applies only to long text mode.

Proprietary channel: Android SDK 3.5.0 and later
parameters.help_zh:
右侧图标URL。
当前支持：
华为EMUI（仅长文本模式、Inbox模式下适用）。

荣耀Magic UI（仅长文本模式下适用）。

自有通道：安卓SDK3.5.0及以上
parameters.name: android_image_url

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] This parameter is deprecated. Starting from August 2023, Xiaomi officially no longer supports dynamically setting small icons, right-side icons, and big pictures during pushes on new devices and systems
parameters.help_zh: 该参数已废弃，小米从 2023.08 开始，官方在新设备/系统已经不再支持推送时动态设置小图标、右侧图标、大图片功能
parameters.name: android_xiaomi_image_url

parameters.help_en:
The body in inbox mode. The content must be a valid JSON array with no more than 5 elements. Supported channels:

Huawei: EMUI 9 and later
Honor: Magic UI 4.0 and later
Xiaomi: MIUI 10 and later
OPPO: ColorOS 5.0 and later
Proprietary channel: Android SDK 3.6.0 and later
parameters.help_zh:
Inbox模式下的正文，内容为合法的JSON Array，且元素不超过5个。当前支持：

华为：EMUI9及以上
荣耀：Magic UI 4.0及以上
小米：MIUI10及以上
OPPO：ColorOS 5.0以上
自有通道：安卓SDK3.6.0及以上
parameters.name: android_inbox_body

parameters.help_en: The custom notification bar style for Android. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: Android自定义通知栏样式，取值：1-100
parameters.name: android_notification_bar_type

parameters.help_en: The priority of the Android notification display position in the notification bar. Valid values: -2, -1, 0, 1, and 2
parameters.help_zh: Android通知在通知栏展示时排列位置的优先级。可取值： -2，-1，0，1，2
parameters.name: android_notification_bar_priority

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of each message when displayed in the notification bar. Different notification bar messages can use the same NotifyId to allow new notification bar messages to overwrite old ones
parameters.help_zh: 标识每条消息在通知显示时的唯一标识，不同的通知栏消息可以相同的NotifyId，实现新的通知栏消息覆盖老的
parameters.name: android_notification_notify_id

parameters.help_en:
The channel ID of the Android application, which must correspond to the channel ID in the application.
For more information about how to set the NotificationChannel parameter, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/67398.html.
Because the channel_id of the OPPO private message channel is the same as the channel ID of the application, this value is used as the channel_id during OPPO channel pushes.
This value is used as the channel_id during Huawei, FCM, and Alibaba Cloud proprietary channel pushes
parameters.help_zh:
Android app的channelId，需要与app中的channelId能对应上。
设置NotificationChannel参数，具体用途请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/67398.html。
因OPPO通知私信通道的channel_id与app的channelId相同，故OPPO通道推送时，channel_id取此值。
华为、FCM、阿里云自有通道推送中，channel_id取此值
parameters.name: android_notification_channel

parameters.help_en:
The importance parameter for Huawei notification message classification, which determines the notification behavior on user devices. Valid values:

LOW: information and marketing messages.
NORMAL: service and communication messages.

For the Huawei channel, we recommend that you use AndroidMessageHuaweiCategory for notification classification instead of AndroidNotificationHuaweiChannel.
Apply for this permission on the Huawei platform. For more information, see Application link (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/development/HMSCore-Guides/message-classification-0000001149358835#section893184112272)
parameters.help_zh:
设置Huawei通知消息分类importance参数，决定用户设备消息通知行为，取值如下：

LOW：资讯营销类消息
NORMAL：服务与通讯类消息

当前华为通道建议使用AndroidMessageHuaweiCategory进行通知分类，可不再使用AndroidNotificationHuaweiChannel。
需要在Huawei平台申请，申请链接 (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/development/HMSCore-Guides/message-classification-0000001149358835#section893184112272)
parameters.name: android_notification_huawei_channel

parameters.help_en:
The importance parameter for Honor notification message classification, which determines the notification behavior on user devices. Valid values:

LOW: information and marketing messages.
NORMAL: service and communication messages.

You must apply for this permission on the Honor platform. For more information, see Application link (https://developer.honor.com/cn/docs/11002/guides/notification-class#%E8%87%AA%E5%88%86%E7%B1%BB%E6%9D%83%E7%9B%8A%E7%94%B3%E8%AF%B7)
parameters.help_zh:
设置荣耀通知消息分类importance参数，决定用户设备消息通知行为，取值如下：

LOW：资讯营销类消息
NORMAL：服务与通讯类消息

需要在荣耀平台申请，申请链接 (https://developer.honor.com/cn/docs/11002/guides/notification-class#%E8%87%AA%E5%88%86%E7%B1%BB%E6%9D%83%E7%9B%8A%E7%94%B3%E8%AF%B7)
parameters.name: android_notification_honor_channel

parameters.help_en:
The channel ID for Xiaomi notification types. You must apply for this permission on the Xiaomi platform. For more information, see Application link (https://dev.mi.com/console/doc/detail?pId=2422#_4).
A single application can apply for a maximum of 8 channels on the Xiaomi channel. Plan ahead
parameters.help_zh:
设置小米通知类型的channelId，需要在小米平台申请，详见：申请链接 (https://dev.mi.com/console/doc/detail?pId=2422#_4)。
小米通道单个应用最多可申请8个channel，请提前做好规划
parameters.name: android_notification_xiaomi_channel

parameters.help_en:
The vivo notification message classification. Valid values:

0: operation messages. This is the default value.
1: system messages.

For the vivo channel, we recommend that you use AndroidMessageVivoCategory for notification classification instead of AndroidNotificationVivoChannel.
Apply for this permission on the vivo platform. For more information, see Application link (https://dev.vivo.com.cn/documentCenter/doc/359)
parameters.help_zh:
设置vivo通知消息分类，取值为：

0：运营类消息（默认）
1：系统类消息

当前vivo通道建议使用AndroidMessageVivoCategory进行通知分类，可不再使用AndroidNotificationVivoChannel。
需要在vivo平台申请，详见：申请链接 (https://dev.vivo.com.cn/documentCenter/doc/359)
parameters.name: android_notification_vivo_channel

parameters.help_en:
The message group. For messages in the same group, only the latest message and the total number of messages received in the group are displayed in the notification bar. All messages are not displayed and cannot be expanded. Supported channels:

Huawei vendor channel
Honor vendor channel
Proprietary channel: Android SDK 3.9.1 and earlier

The proprietary channel no longer supports this parameter in Android SDK 3.9.2 and later
parameters.help_zh:
消息分组，同一组消息在通知栏里只显示最新一条和当前该组接受到的消息总数目，不会展示所有消息也无法展开。当前支持：

华为厂商通道
荣耀厂商通道
自有通道 安卓 SDK3.9.1 及以下

自有通道在安卓 SDK3.9.2 及以上的版本不再支持此参数
parameters.name: android_notification_group

parameters.help_en:
The message thread ID. Messages in the same group are collapsed and can be expanded in the notification bar. Notifications in different groups are displayed separately. Supported channels:

Proprietary channel: Android SDK 3.9.2 and later
parameters.help_zh:
消息分组，同一组消息在通知栏里折叠展示，可展开，不同组通知分开展示。当前支持：

自有通道 安卓 SDK3.9.2 及以上
parameters.name: android_notification_thread_id

parameters.help_en:
The extended properties of the notification. This parameter does not take effect when PushType is set to MESSAGE.

This parameter must be passed in JSON map format. Otherwise, a parsing error occurs
parameters.help_zh:
设定通知的扩展属性。当推送类型PushType设置为MESSAGE消息类型时，该属性不生效。

该参数要以JSON map的格式传入，否则会解析出错
parameters.name: android_ext_parameters

parameters.help_en:
The delivery priority for Huawei channel notifications. Valid values:

HIGH
NORMAL

You must apply for this permission. For more information, see Application link (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/development/HMSCore-Guides/faq-0000001050042183#section037425218509)
parameters.help_zh:
华为通道通知投递优先级，取值如下：

HIGH
NORMAL

需要申请权限，具体请参见：申请链接 (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/development/HMSCore-Guides/faq-0000001050042183#section037425218509)
parameters.name: android_message_huawei_urgency

parameters.help_en:
Purpose 1: After you complete the self-classification permission application (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/development/HMSCore-Guides/message-classification-0000001149358835?#section3410731125514), this parameter is used to identify the message type, determine the message reminder method (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/development/HMSCore-Guides/message-classification-0000001149358835#ZH-CN_TOPIC_0000001149358835__p3850133955718), and accelerate the delivery of specific types of messages. For valid values, refer to the message classification standards (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/development/HMSCore-Guides/message-classification-0000001149358835#section1076611477914) in the official Huawei push documentation, and enter the cloud notification category value or local notification category value from the table.

Purpose 2: After you apply for special permissions (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/development/HMSCore-Guides/faq-0000001050042183#section037425218509), this parameter is used to identify high-priority pass-through scenarios. Valid values:
VOIP: audio and video calls.
PLAY_VOICE: voice broadcast.

If the cloud notification category value is N/A, the Alibaba Cloud proprietary channel is used. If the local notification category value is N/A, the Huawei channel is used
parameters.help_zh:
作用一：完成自分类权益申请 (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/development/HMSCore-Guides/message-classification-0000001149358835?#section3410731125514)后，用于标识消息类型，确定消息提醒方式 (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/development/HMSCore-Guides/message-classification-0000001149358835#ZH-CN_TOPIC_0000001149358835__p3850133955718)，对特定类型消息加快发送，取值请参考华为推送官方文档的消息分类标准 (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/development/HMSCore-Guides/message-classification-0000001149358835#section1076611477914)，填写文档表格中的“云端通知category取值”或“本地通知category取值”。

作用二：申请特殊权限 (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/development/HMSCore-Guides/faq-0000001050042183#section037425218509)后，用于标识高优先级透传场景，取值如下：
VOIP：音视频通话
PLAY_VOICE：语音播报

对于“云端通知category取值”为“不涉及”的一概走阿里云自有通道，对于“本地通知category取值”为“不涉及”的一概走华为通道
parameters.name: android_message_huawei_category

parameters.help_en:
OPPO message categorization includes two categories: communication and service, and content and marketing.

Communication and service (permission application required):
IM: instant chat, audio calls, and video calls.
ACCOUNT: individual account and asset changes.
DEVICE_REMINDER: personal device reminders.
ORDER: personal order and logistics status changes.
TODO: personal schedules and to-do lists.
SUBSCRIPTION: individual subscribe.

Content and marketing:
NEWS: news and information.
CONTENT: content recommendations.
MARKETING: platform activities.
SOCIAL: social updates.

For more information, see OPUSH message classification rules (https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=13189)
parameters.help_zh:
OPPO将消息分类：通讯与服务、内容与营销两个类别进行管理。

通讯与服务（需申请权限）：
IM：即时聊天、音频、视频通话
ACCOUNT：个人账号与资产变化
DEVICE_REMINDER：个人设备提醒
ORDER：个人订单/物流状态变化
TODO：个人日程/待办
SUBSCRIPTION：个人订阅

内容与营销：
NEWS：新闻资讯
CONTENT：内容推荐
MARKETING：平台活动
SOCIAL：社交动态

详细请参考OPUSH消息分类细则 (https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=13189)
parameters.name: android_message_oppo_category

parameters.help_en:
The notification level for OPPO channel notification bar messages. Valid values:
1: notification bar.
2: notification bar, lock screen, ringtone, and vibration. This is the default notification level for communication and service messages.
16: notification bar, lock screen, ringtone, vibration, and banner. Permission application is required.

When you use the AndroidMessageOppoNotifyLevel parameter, you must also pass the AndroidMessageOppoCategory parameter
parameters.help_zh:
OPPO通道通知栏消息提醒等级。可取值为：
1：通知栏
2：通知栏、锁屏、铃声、振动（通讯与服务类消息默认通知级别）
16：通知栏、锁屏、铃声、振动、横幅（需申请权限）

使用AndroidMessageOppoNotifyLevel参数时，必须同时传AndroidMessageOppoCategory参数
parameters.name: android_message_oppo_notify_level

parameters.help_en:
vivo message categorization includes two categories: system messages and operation messages.
System messages:
IM: instant messages.
ACCOUNT: accounts and assets.
TODO: schedules and to-do lists.
DEVICE_REMINDER: device information.
ORDER: orders and logistics.
SUBSCRIPTION: subscribe reminders.

Operation messages:
NEWS: news.
CONTENT: content recommendations.
MARKETING: operational activity.
SOCIAL: social updates.

For more information, see Classification description (https://dev.vivo.com.cn/documentCenter/doc/359#s-ef3qugc3)
parameters.help_zh:
vivo将消息分为：系统消息、运营消息两个类别进行管理。
系统消息：
IM：即时消息
ACCOUNT：账号与资产
TODO：日程待办
DEVICE_REMINDER：设备信息
ORDER：订单与物流
SUBSCRIPTION：订阅提醒

运营消息：
NEWS：新闻
CONTENT：内容推荐
MARKETING：运营活动
SOCIAL：社交动态

详细请参考分类说明 (https://dev.vivo.com.cn/documentCenter/doc/359#s-ef3qugc3)
parameters.name: android_message_vivo_category

parameters.help_en:
Settings for the vendor channel notification type. Valid values:
0: formal notification. This is the default value.
1: test notification.

The parameter settings are equivalent to configuring the AndroidHuaweiTargetUserType, AndroidHonorTargetUserType, AndroidVivoPushMode, and AndroidOppoIntentEnv parameters at the same time. The corresponding parameters for specific vendor channels can overwrite this parameter.
Supported channels: Huawei, Honor, vivo, and OPPO Fluid Cloud
parameters.help_zh:
设置厂商通道通知类型：
0：正式通知（默认）。
1：测试通知。

本参数配置后等价于同时配置AndroidHuaweiTargetUserType、AndroidHonorTargetUserType、AndroidVivoPushMode、AndroidOppoIntentEnv四个参数，具体厂商通道的对应参数能覆盖本参数。
当前支持：华为通道、荣耀通道、vivo通道、OPPO流体云
parameters.name: android_target_user_type

parameters.help_en:
The notification type for the Huawei channel. Valid values:
0: formal notification. This is the default value.
1: test notification.

Each application can send 500 test notifications per day, which is not subject to the daily push limit per device
parameters.help_zh:
设置华为通道通知类型：
0：正式通知（默认）。
1：测试通知。

每个应用每日可发送该测试通知500条且不受每日单设备推送数量上限要求
parameters.name: android_huawei_target_user_type

parameters.help_en:
The notification type for the Honor channel. Valid values:
0: formal notification. This is the default value.
1: test notification.

Each application can send 1,000 test notifications per day, which is not subject to the daily push limit per device
parameters.help_zh:
设置荣耀通道通知类型：
0：正式通知（默认）。
1：测试通知。

每个应用每日可发送该测试通知1000条且不受每日单设备推送数量上限要求
parameters.name: android_honor_target_user_type

parameters.help_en:
The push type for the vivo channel. Valid values:
0: formal push. This is the default value.
1: test push.

For test pushes, configure test devices in the vivo console in advance. You can obtain the RegId of a test device by searching for onReceiveRegId regId in the device startup log
parameters.help_zh:
设置vivo通道通知类型：
0：正式推送（默认）。
1：测试推送。

测试推送请事先在vivo控制台配置测试设备。测试设备RegId可在设备启动日志中搜索“onReceiveRegId regId”获得
parameters.name: android_vivo_push_mode

parameters.help_en:
The push environment for OPPO Fluid Cloud. Valid values:
0: formal environment. This is the default value.
1: test environment.

To use the OPPO Fluid Cloud test environment, you must build the environment on the client side by referring to Environment setup (https://open.oppomobile.com/documentation/page/info?id=13590)
parameters.help_zh:
设置OPPO流体云推送环境
0：正式环境（默认）。
1：测试环境。

OPPO流体云测试环境需要参考环境搭建 (https://open.oppomobile.com/documentation/page/info?id=13590)在客户端搭建
parameters.name: android_oppo_intent_env

parameters.help_en:
The Huawei quick notification parameter. Valid values:
0: sends standard Huawei notifications. This is the default value.
1: sends Huawei quick notifications
parameters.help_zh:
设置华为快通知参数
0：发送华为普通通知（默认）。
1：发送华为快通知
parameters.name: android_huawei_business_type

parameters.help_en:
The receipt ID for the Huawei channel. You can view this receipt ID in the receipt parameter settings on the Huawei push operations platform.

If the default receipt configuration on the Huawei push operations platform is set to the Alibaba Cloud receipt, you do not need to provide this parameter. Otherwise, configure the default receipt ID for the Huawei channel in the Alibaba Cloud EMAS shift push console first
parameters.help_zh:
华为通道回执ID，该回执ID可以在华为通道推送运营平台的回执参数配置中查看。

如果在华为通道推送运营平台配置的默认回执配置是阿里云回执，则无需提供，如果不是，建议优先在阿里云EMAS移动推送控制台中配置华为通道默认回执ID
parameters.name: android_huawei_receipt_id

parameters.help_en:
The receipt ID for the vivo channel. You can view this receipt ID in the application information of the push service on the vivo Open Platform.

If the default receipt configuration on the vivo Open Platform is set to the Alibaba Cloud receipt, you do not need to provide this parameter. Otherwise, configure the default receipt ID for the vivo channel in the Alibaba Cloud EMAS Mobile Push console first
parameters.help_zh:
vivo通道回执ID，该回执ID可以在vivo开放平台推送服务的应用信息中查看。

如果在vivo开放平台配置的默认回执配置是阿里云回执，则无需提供，如果不是，建议优先在阿里云EMAS移动推送控制台中配置vivo通道默认回执ID

SUBSCRIPTION：订阅
TRAVEL：出行
HEALTH：健康
WORK：工作事项提醒
ACCOUNT：账号动态
EXPRESS：订单&物流
